sections.heading: STANDARD RULES
sections.text: (1)Any person operating a motor vehicle must; (a) drive on the right and pass on the left - if a two way road has a center marking, they must stay to the right of it unless overtaking or maneuvering past an obstacle in the road; (b)when making turns, changing between lanes on a one-way road, or overtaking on a two-way road, in a vehicles fitted with indicators, they must use them to signal other road users of their intention to make a turn; (c) show courtesy and respect to other motorists whilst operating their own vehicle; and (d)stop their vehicles upon the presence of a red traffic light or stop sign. Any failure to follow these shall be guilty of violating standard traffic rules. (2)This is a Class G offense.

sections.heading: VEHICULAR RIGHT OF WAY
sections.text: (1)All persons operating a vehicle must give their right of way to; (a) other vehicles if a road sign or marking signals them to 'Give way' or 'Stop’; (b)other vehicles coming the other way if an obstruction on their side of the road, such as a parked car, does not give them sufficient space to pass them; (c) other vehicles if they are attempting to join a road from a slip road, private road, or offroad; and (d)emergency vehicles when their emergency lighting is turned on. Any failure to follow these shall be guilty of violating vehicular right of way. (2)This is a Class G offense.

sections.heading: PEDESTRIAN RIGHT OF WAY
sections.text:
(a) All persons operating a vehicle must give their right of way to pedestrians if they are in the process of crossing a road.
(b)Pedestrians have a right of way to cross the road if they are doing so on a pedestrian crossing. (c) Pedestrians may not walk on a road if— (i) they are continuously obstructing the flow of vehicle traffic; or (ii) they are not able to move out of the way of passing vehicles. (d)Any failure to follow these shall be guilty of violating pedestrian right of way. (e) This is a Class G offense.

sections.heading: PARKING
sections.text: (a) All persons operating a vehicle must not park in such a way that obstructs the flow of traffic, or obstructs the movement of other parked vehicles, unless the clear consent of the owner of the obstructed vehicle is given. (b)All persons operating a vehicle must not park; on footpaths, in intersections, in designated taxi/bus lanes, on a median strip, on or across a driveway, incorrectly with painted parking lines or double park their vehicle. (c) A person who commits this offense shall be guilty of Incorrect Parking. (d)This shall be a Class G offense.

sections.heading: SPEED LIMITS
sections.text: (a) All persons operating a vehicle travel at or below 70 m/h (seventy miles per hour) in city areas such as those with housing or street lighting. (b)All persons operating a vehicle travel at or below 55 km/h (fifty five miles per hour) outside of governmental buildings, including but not limited to; (i) The White House; (ii) Town Hall; (iii) Congressional Offices; (iv) Harry S Truman Building (Department of State); (v) United Nations Building; (vi) District Courts; (vii) National Guard Headquarters and; (viii) Department of Homeland Security. (c) All persons operating a vehicle exceeding the applicable speed limit are guilty of Speeding. (d)This shall be a Class G offense.

sections.heading: EMERGENCY VEHICLES
sections.text: (a) All lawfully permitted persons operating an emergency vehicle are exempt from Chapter 8 of this act when responding to an emergency. (b)No person shall block or cause disruption towards an emergency vehicle that has utilised its lights and sirens. (c) A person who commits this offense shall be guilty of Failing to Create a Path for an Emergency Vehicle. (d)This is a Class F offense.

sections.heading: RECKLESS DRIVING
sections.text: (a) All persons operating a vehicle in a manner that is dangerous to the public, having regard to all the circumstances, including the nature, condition and use of the road, and the amount of traffic which is, or might reasonably be expected to be, on the road, is guilty of reckless driving. (b)This is a Class G offense.

sections.heading: FAILURE TO STOP
sections.text: (a) All persons operating a vehicle who fail to yield to a law enforcement officer attempting to pull them over shall be guilty of failure to stop. (b)This is a Class E offense.

sections.heading: OVERTAKING AND PASSAGE
sections.text: (a) All persons operating a vehicle who overtake or pass another vehicle in a manner that is dangerous or causes inconvenience to other road users shall be guilty of unlawful overtaking. (b)This is a Class G offense.

sections.heading: MOTOR EVASION
sections.text: (a) Any person who flees the scene of a crime or evades any law enforcement official with the use of any motor vehicle or aircraft after failing to comply with any and all visual, verbal, sonic signs or clearly interpretable actions or signals by an Officer, shall be guilty of Motor Evasion. (b)This shall be a Class E Offense.

sections.heading: OBSTRUCTING TRAFFIC
sections.text:
(1)Any person who obstructs, closes or tampers with the accessibility of a road, sidewalk or highway with any tool,
object or themselves without legal authority or standing to do so, shall be guilty of Obstructing Traffic. (2)This shall be a Class G Offense.
